title: Storm-Watch Reserve Compliance
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powerwall:aggregate mode=storm_watch
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(battery_soc_pct) as max_soc by _time
| where max_soc<90
| sort - _time
description: Checks whether storm-watch or backup-reserve behaviour actually filled the battery to a high enough level before bad weather arrived.
value: A backup battery only protects you if the reserve policy did what you expected; this turns trust in automation into a verifiable control.
implementation: Forward battery mode and state-of-charge; review each storm-watch day and tune reserve settings if the pack never gets sufficiently full.
visualization: Daily table of storm-watch days and maximum state of charge reached.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces whether the house battery really filled up for storm backup when bad weather mode turned on.
